B02.reason: No audio-aware generative section replacement operation exists in the current runtime.

B03.reason: Lyrics can be edited as text, but there is no local audio lyric replacement operation.

B04.reason: Runtime explicitly marks vocal conversion unavailable; no identity-preserving regeneration exists.

B05.reason: PT-BR lyric analysis exists, but no sung-vocal generation exists locally.

The high adaptive-partial path has one verified historical execution; the low path is implemented but deliberately marked unexecuted. B07 remains unscored and non-promotable until both frozen high and low layers are rendered against benchmark inputs and retained.

B08.reason: Mixer and effects can change presentation, but no arrangement-generation operation preserves melody/lyrics/identity under benchmark constraints.

B09.reason: Runtime explicitly marks stem separation unavailable. Demucs engine evidence exists, but no completed standalone stems render_job exists yet; per-track export is not counted as source separation.

B10.reason: A deterministic PT-BR conversational edit engine maps the frozen non-DAW command to exact supported local operations, scopes preservation to the explicit clause, and fails closed on unsupported requests. Retained execution evidence is still required before scoring.

B11.reason: A guarded three-step conversational edit sequence preserves project identity, lyrics, track order, all non-selected tracks, selected source identity, duration/sample layout, offset/trim/gain/mute/solo while allowing only requested supported effect/pan changes. Acoustic continuity evidence is still required before scoring the hard gate.

B12.reason: Master WAV render exists; aligned stereo per-track rendering preserves project duration, avoids per-stem normalization, rejects >0 dBFS stems instead of silently clipping, and fixes master channel selection. Benchmark output still must be executed and retained before scoring.

promotion_rule: Implementation readiness is not a benchmark pass. A test becomes scorable only after its full required operation produces retained output evidence against the frozen inputs.
